purpose: Keep ACE directly addressable to humans and agents while allowing the same inspectable engine to be invoked embedded or autonomically during Aurora operation.

interactive.description: A human, operator, or agent deliberately queries ACE.

embedded.description: A registered Aurora capability or agent calls ACE inside a larger workflow.

autonomic.description: A registered policy or subsystem detects a qualifying coherence seam and invokes ACE.

hard_rules: ACE remains a first-class named tool and MUST remain directly addressable by humans and agents.
Interactive, embedded, and autonomic invocations MUST use the same ACE engine and determination contracts.
Automatic invocation MUST NOT become invisible latent capability; substantive invocations remain inspectable and attributable.
ACE MUST prefer and compose eligible registered Aurora capabilities before bounded synthesis.
ACE MUST NOT synthesize around an available eligible specialist or authoritative procedure.
Invocation mode does not grant side-effect, materialization, canon, or cross-layer authority.
Autonomic invocation requires an upstream seam reference and trigger-policy reference.
The subsystem that detects a seam owns detection; ACE owns capability composition and determination after invocation.
Every successful execution MUST preserve a link from invocation envelope to ACE query and determination.
